vocabulary.capacity_policy: A reported, event- or layout-specific number with year and spatial boundary; never inferred from area.
vocabulary.annual_visitation_policy: Square-level operator counts only; distinguish visits, unique people and museum admissions. Missing is null, never zero.
vocabulary.weekday_holiday_policy: Qualitative paired programme comparison unless a matched count series is available. No invented peak multiplier.
vocabulary.population_policy: Municipal/LGA scope, reference date and registry/ERP method stated; metropolitan figures separate.
vocabulary.coverage_policy: Metric union of footprint polygons clipped to a 600m square; denominator includes water; source epoch and semantics retained.

label: 所在城市人口
City population
scope: 2025-12-31；Comune di Venezia全市镇，含大陆地区；不是历史岛城人口。
31 Dec 2025; municipality including the mainland, not the historic islands alone.

label: 公布广场面积
Published plaza area
scope: Piazza主体，不含Piazzetta；意大利语维基百科公布值，属二级来源。
Piazza proper, excluding Piazzetta; published Italian Wikipedia value, a secondary source.

label: 公布活动容量
Published event capacity
scope: 2018年Volo dell’Angelo活动限额；不是当前全时段容量。
2018 Flight of the Angel event cap; not a current permanent capacity.
metrics.measurement: event- or configuration-specific; not a permanent universal maximum

label: 广场年到访量
Annual square visitation
scope: 未取得广场级完整年度统计；不以威尼斯全市游客量或教堂入场人数替代。
No complete square-level annual series found; city tourism and basilica admissions are excluded.

label: 600米图幅建筑覆盖率
Buildings in the 600 m frame
scope: 统一600 × 600米图幅；合并并裁切真实建筑轮廓后计算。分母含水面；不是公共开放率。
Union of source footprints clipped to the same 600 × 600 m frame. Denominator includes water; not a public-open-space ratio.
metrics.measurement: computed footprint union / 360000 m²; source dates differ

label: 空间形态
Spatial form
text: Piazza、柱廊与Piazzetta形成由围合到水岸的清晰序列。
Piazza, arcades and Piazzetta form a legible sequence from enclosure to waterfront.

label: 交通可达性
Public transport
text: 以水上巴士加步行为主；不是汽车直达型广场。
Waterbus plus walking is the principal approach, not direct car access.

label: 景观融入
Landscape integration
text: 以潟湖水岸及硬质铺地为主，广场核心并非植被公园。
Lagoon frontage and paving dominate; the square core is not a planted park.

label: 商业界面
Commercial edges
text: 咖啡座与商铺沿建筑边缘展开；商业座位不能等同免费公共座位。
Cafes and shops line the edges; commercial seats are not free public seating.

label: 气候适应
Climate response
text: 夏季日晒与湿热、降雨及异常高潮位影响使用；覆盖边缘和预警是主要应对。
Summer sun and humidity, rain and high tides affect use; covered edges and warnings provide responses.

label: 使用功能
Use programme
text: 穿行／停留／文化参观／公共活动四类功能并存。
Passage / staying / cultural visits / public events coexist.

label: 平日／节假日
Ordinary / holiday use
text: 平日以游览、步行和外摆为主；狂欢节等活动可限制入口和容量。
Ordinary days emphasise visits, walking and terraces; Carnival events can impose entry and capacity limits.

label: 容量与年到访量
Capacity & annual visitation
text: 2018活动上限20,000人；广场级年到访量未确认。
2018 event cap: 20,000; square-level annual visitation remains unestablished.

label: 科技接入
Technology
text: 活动限流使用数字计数设备；潮汐监测与预警服务通行，非娱乐屏幕主导。
Digital event counting and tide warnings support management; entertainment screens are not the defining infrastructure.

label: 服务对象
Community / tourism
text: 服务社区仪式与公共生活，同时是全球游客目的地；不赋虚构居民／游客比例。
Serves civic rituals and public life as well as global visitors; no resident/tourist percentage is invented.

title: 连续柱廊
Continuous arcades
text: 把建筑立面转化为有遮蔽、可穿行的公共边缘。
Turns building fronts into covered, walkable public edges.

title: 广场—水岸序列
Square–waterfront sequence
text: 从围合的Piazza经过Piazzetta到潟湖，空间有方向也有变化。
Moves from enclosed Piazza through Piazzetta to lagoon with both direction and variety.

title: 仪式与日常共用
Ritual and everyday sharing
text: 同一公共地面容纳日常穿行、文化参观及城市仪式。
One civic ground supports daily passage, cultural visits and civic ritual.

label: 所在城市人口
City population
scope: 2025-12-31；Comune di Siena全市镇注册常住人口，不是省级人口。
31 Dec 2025; municipal registered residents, not the province.

label: 公布广场面积
Published plaza area
scope: Sepe等2021论文所列广场表面积；此处四舍五入显示，不由图像推算。
Square surface area listed in Sepe et al. 2021; display rounded, not measured from an image.

label: 公布活动容量
Published event capacity
scope: 2026 Palio中央站立区，赛事安保方说明；不含所有外围看台，也不是平日固定上限。
2026 Palio central standing area, per event security provider; not all grandstands or a permanent ordinary-day limit.
metrics.measurement: event- or configuration-specific; not a permanent universal maximum

label: 广场年到访量
Annual square visitation
scope: 未取得广场级完整年度统计；不使用全市住宿人次替代。
No complete square-level annual count found; city accommodation nights are excluded.

label: 常规Palio场次
Regular Palio races
scope: 常规日期7月2日与8月16日，可因天气延期；不是广场全部年度活动数。
Regular dates: 2 July and 16 August; weather postponements possible. Not the total square event count.

label: 600米图幅建筑覆盖率
Buildings in the 600 m frame
scope: 统一600 × 600米图幅；合并并裁切真实建筑轮廓后计算。分母含水面；不是公共开放率。
Union of source footprints clipped to the same 600 × 600 m frame. Denominator includes water; not a public-open-space ratio.
metrics.measurement: computed footprint union / 360000 m²; source dates differ

label: 空间形态
Spatial form
text: 壳形坡面与低侧市政宫共同形成观看和停留方向。
Shell-shaped ground and the low-side palace establish direction for viewing and staying.

label: 交通可达性
Public transport
text: 火车与公交衔接历史中心，最终步行进入广场。
Rail and buses connect to the historic centre, with a final pedestrian approach.

label: 景观融入
Landscape integration
text: 坡地与喷泉融入空间体验；核心为硬质铺装，而非连续绿地。
Slope and fountain shape experience; the core is paved rather than continuous planted land.

label: 商业界面
Commercial edges
text: 餐饮与外摆沿边缘展开，中心仍承担免费停留与公共活动。
Dining and terraces occupy edges while the centre supports informal stay and civic events.

label: 气候适应
Climate response
text: 夏季需避晒，凉季有雨；原LaMMA基准年降雨785.7 mm（1961—1990），不是当前年度。
Summer sun and cool-season rain matter; LaMMA’s baseline annual rainfall is 785.7 mm (1961–1990), not a current-year total.

label: 使用功能
Use programme
text: 穿行／停留／文化参观／公共活动四类并存，Palio是特定时段的转换。
Passage / staying / cultural visits / public events coexist, with Palio as a timed transformation.

label: 平日／节假日
Ordinary / holiday use
text: 平日坐卧和穿行；Palio常规每年2场，赛事时配置赛道、围栏和受控入口。
Ordinary sitting and passage change to track, barriers and controlled entries for the two regular annual Palio races.

label: 容量与年到访量
Capacity & annual visitation
text: 2026安保执行记录为中央区约15,000人；不是全广场人数，也没有广场年量。
2026 provider account: approximately 15,000 in the centre; not a whole-square total. Annual square count unavailable.

label: 科技接入
Technology
text: 数字交通信息与赛事流量管理为主；未证实核心广场有常设大型数字艺术屏。
Digital transit information and event-flow management are documented; no permanent large digital-art screen in the core is established.

label: 服务对象
Community / tourism
text: Contrade组织和Palio体现社区作用，同时是世界性游客目的地。
Contrade and Palio express community roles alongside international tourism.

title: 可坐卧的坡地
An inhabitable slope
text: 地面本身就参与停留与观看，而不只是一片铺装。
Ground itself supports staying and viewing rather than acting only as paving.

title: 街巷收束与展开
Compression and release
text: 狭窄街巷在进入广场时突然开敞，增强整体空间辨识。
Narrow lanes release into the square, strengthening its spatial identity.

title: 社区仪式的延续
Continuity of civic ritual
text: Palio将地方社区和公共地面持续联系起来。
Palio keeps local communities connected to civic ground.

label: 所在城市人口
City population
scope: 2025-06-30；City of Melbourne LGA，ABS估计常住人口；大墨尔本另为5,435,590人。
30 Jun 2025; City of Melbourne LGA estimated residents (ABS); Greater Melbourne separately has 5,435,590.

label: 公布广场面积
Published plaza area
scope: Karres en Brands设计资料中的广场面积；运营方现行Main Square场租区域另为5,000 m²。
Plaza area in the landscape designer’s account; current Main Square hire area is separately 5,000 m².

label: 公布活动容量
Published event capacity
scope: 现行Main Square场地页面公布容量；实际活动配置和审批可能更低。
Current Main Square venue listing; actual event layouts and approvals may be lower.
metrics.measurement: event- or configuration-specific; not a permanent universal maximum

label: 广场年到访量
Annual square visitation
scope: 2025–26财年，运营方年报，printed p26；按其Visitors口径，不宣称为去重人数。
FY2025–26 operator report, printed p26; reported “Visitors”, not established as unique individuals.
metrics.measurement: operator reported visitors; uniqueness not specified

label: 年度活动数
Annual events
scope: 2025–26年报列示；其中37项社区与文化活动，支持114个社区组织。
FY2025–26 report; 37 community/cultural events and 114 community organisations supported.

label: 600米图幅建筑覆盖率
Buildings in the 600 m frame
scope: 统一600 × 600米图幅；合并并裁切真实建筑轮廓后计算。分母含水面；不是公共开放率。
Union of source footprints clipped to the same 600 × 600 m frame. Denominator includes water; not a public-open-space ratio.
metrics.measurement: computed footprint union / 360000 m²; source dates differ

label: 空间形态
Spatial form
text: 铁路上盖创造连续公共地面，向东整体抬升约6米。
A rail deck creates civic ground with an approximately 6 m eastward rise.

label: 交通可达性
Public transport
text: 火车、电车与步行连接CBD及河岸，是高可达的文化节点。
Rail, tram and walking connect CBD and river in a highly accessible cultural node.

label: 景观融入
Landscape integration
text: Yarra河形成背景；2025年车库屋顶Test Garden增加植物景观，不能当作2002原广场绿化。
Yarra provides context; the 2025 car-park-roof Test Garden adds planting and is not original 2002 plaza greenery.

label: 商业界面
Commercial edges
text: 餐饮、酒吧和文化零售沿建筑边缘分布，与免费公共活动并存。
Dining, bars and cultural retail line buildings alongside free public programming.

label: 气候适应
Climate response
text: Atrium覆盖空间和Labyrinth被动环境系统补充室外使用；不宣称露天广场全年舒适。
Atrium cover and Labyrinth passive conditioning complement outdoor use; year-round outdoor comfort is not claimed.

label: 使用功能
Use programme
text: 穿行／停留／文化参观／公共活动四类并存，兼有公共集会。
Passage / staying / cultural visits / public events coexist, including civic assemblies.

label: 平日／节假日
Ordinary / holiday use
text: 普通日自由到访与社区课程，节庆／比赛日形成舞台、屏幕和临时围合。
Ordinary visits and community classes shift to stages, screens and temporary enclosures on celebration and sport days.

label: 容量与年到访量
Capacity & annual visitation
text: Main Square公布10,000人容量；2025–26年到访1,190万以上、389场活动，口径分别保留。
Main Square lists 10,000 capacity; FY2025–26 reports 11.9m+ visitors and 389 events, with scopes kept separate.

label: 科技接入
Technology
text: 场地页列65 m² Digital Façade、音响及听力辅助；另有Labyrinth与环境监测系统。
Venue lists a 65 m² Digital Façade, sound and hearing support, alongside Labyrinth and environmental monitoring.

label: 服务对象
Community / tourism
text: 2025–26支持114个社区组织；同时承接都市文化参观与游客，不能只写成旅游景点。
114 community organisations supported in FY2025–26, alongside cultural visitors and tourists; more than a tourism attraction.

title: 基础设施上的公共地面
Civic ground over infrastructure
text: 通过铁路上盖与坡地，把原本分隔的城市关系重新连接。
Deck and slope reconnect urban relationships separated by rail.

title: 室内外互补
Indoor/outdoor complement
text: Atrium为露天广场补充覆盖空间与文化入口。
Atrium supplements the outdoor plaza with cover and cultural entrances.

title: 文化与数字活动平台
Cultural and digital platform
text: 文化机构、数字屏幕与全年活动支持社区和游客共同使用。
Institutions, screen and year-round programming support both communities and visitors.
